content:
NORTHBRIDGE HOLDINGS GROUP — FY 2025 ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT (AUDITED)

Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2025 | Independent Auditor: Vanguard & Mercer LLP (Synthetic)

1. Consolidated Financial Highlights
- Total FY 2025 Revenue: $128.4M
- Cost of Revenue: $48.8M
- Gross Profit: $79.6M (62.0% gross margin)
- Operating Expenses: $55.5M
- Adjusted EBITDA: $24.1M
- Cash & Short-Term Equivalents (as of Dec 31, 2025): $31.2M
- Total Long-Term Debt: $8.5M

2. Capital Allocation
R&D infrastructure investment totaled $14.9M in FY 2025, focused on compliance automation and read-only audit telemetry.

3. Governance Notice
Individual executive compensation schedules are maintained separately under RESTRICTED classification and omitted from the general annual financial report.
